# Blood Pact

![Blood Pact](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/blood_pact.png)

Heads: next Blood coin gains 8 points on Heads or adds 4 quota on Tails. Edge gets half of both.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 58%
- **Shop price:** 32 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0
